name: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
languages: English*, Hindi**languages with full audio support
short: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.
about: A first-person supernatural horror experience inspired by the chilling legends of  Bhangarh Fort - India’s most haunted place.   Uncover the tragic story of  Princess Ratnavati  and the infamous  sorcerer Singhia , whose forbidden curse doomed the entire fort and everyone within its walls.  You play as  Vikram Avasthi , searching for your missing brother Sameer - a paranormal investigator who entered the forbidden ruins and vanished without a trace. What begins as a simple search spirals into a descent through ancient temples, ritual chambers, hidden passageways, and the terrifying truth buried deep within Bhangarh’s folklore.  Every corner holds a clue. Every shadow hides a presence. Every step pulls you deeper into the centuries-old curse that binds Ratnavati to this world.   ONE FORT , MANY FATES.... CHOOSE WISELY      FEATURES:      A Folklore-Driven Indian Horror Experience  Story inspired by real myths and local lore.                 Atmospheric First-Person Horror  Slow-burn tension, immersive sound design, and psychological jump scares .                 Explore India’s Most Haunted Location  Walk through detailed temples, palace ruins, courtyards, underground passages, and ritual chambers.     Environmental Puzzles & Rituals  Solve culturally inspired puzzles involving idols, shrines, seals, and supernatural mechanisms.                 Cinematic Cutscenes & Supernatural Events  Experience dramatic horror sequences that blend folklore, mystery, and psychological dread.                 Multiple Endings  Your choices and discoveries influence which fate you meet inside the cursed fort.       DISCLAIMER:     This game is a work of fiction.  While the narrative draws inspiration from Indian folklore and legends, all characters, names, locations, and events are products of the developer's imagination or are used fictitiously. The game does not claim historical accuracy and is designed solely for entertainment purposes. The developers respect all cultures and beliefs; there is no intent to hurt the sentiments of any community or religion. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or real historical events is purely coincidental.
